about: An event of an account's passkey log, as text: `arugula passkey log v1`, then account, seq, prev (the event before's hash, or 64 zeros), event (added or removed), credential, rp, alg, key (its format and base64url), aaguid, at and by, one a line, each ending in a newline. A `by passkey` event has a proof line after it, `proof <credential> <clientDataJSON> <authenticatorData> <signature>`, the signer's assertion. Its hash is SHA-256 of the body and the proof line, hex; what the proof signs (its challenge) is SHA-256 of the body alone, base64url.
